name: Katong & Joo Chiat
summary: Peranakan shophouses, food streets, and character housing with east-side energy.
body: Katong and Joo Chiat sit just inland from East Coast with denser street life — kaya toast, heritage façades, and a younger evening crowd on Joo Chiat Road. Conservation shophouses and boutique apartments attract people who want texture over tower amenities. Parking and unit quirks (stairs, noise, humidity) are real; the trade is neighbourhood personality you cannot get in a new CBD condo.
commuteNotes: Dakota / Paya Lebar / Marine Parade MRT options depending on pocket.
